destinations.title: Explore Albania with Your Rental Car from Tirana Airport
destinations.subtitle: From Mother Teresa Airport (TIA), the whole of Albania is within reach
destinations.intro: Your car rental tirana airport journey opens the door to one of Europe's most beautiful and least-discovered countries. Albania offers pristine Adriatic and Ionian beaches, UNESCO heritage cities, ancient Illyrian ruins, and dramatic mountain landscapes — all within a few hours' drive of Tirana International Airport. Here are the most popular destinations our customers explore with their rental cars:

places.name: Durrës — 35 km · 30 min
places.desc: Albania's main coastal city and most popular beach destination. Drive along the wide sandy beaches of the Adriatic coast, explore one of the largest Roman amphitheaters in the Balkans, and enjoy the vibrant seafront promenade. Perfect for a same-day trip directly from Tirana Airport.

places.name: Berat — 120 km · 1h 30min
places.desc: A UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of Albania's most photographed cities, known as the 'City of a Thousand Windows.' The beautifully preserved Ottoman old town sits along the Osum River, dominated by a medieval hilltop castle with panoramic views over the valley.

places.name: Vlorë — 150 km · 2h
places.desc: The gateway to the Albanian Riviera and the birthplace of Albanian independence in 1912. Surrounded by crystal-clear Adriatic and Ionian waters, Vlorë is the ideal base for exploring the stunning Llogara Pass, the Karaburun Peninsula, and the southern coastal villages.

places.name: Shkodër — 110 km · 1h 20min
places.desc: Northern Albania's cultural capital and gateway to the Albanian Alps. Visit the iconic Rozafa Castle overlooking Lake Shkodër, explore the historic bazaar, and use Shkodër as your base for adventures into the Accursed Mountains (Alpet Shqiptare) — Europe's last true wilderness.

places.name: Sarandë — 280 km · 3h 30min
places.desc: The jewel of the Albanian Riviera and one of the Mediterranean's best-kept secrets. Visit the ancient ruins of Butrint (UNESCO World Heritage), swim in the turquoise waters of the Blue Eye (Syri i Kaltër) spring, and relax on the white-sand beaches of Ksamil. Ideal for a 4-5 day road trip from Tirana Airport.

rentalGuide.title: Your Complete Guide to Renting a Car at Tirana Airport
rentalGuide.subtitle: Everything you need to know before collecting your keys

items.title: Documents required for airport car rental
items.desc: To rent a car at Tirana Airport you need three things: a valid driving license held for at least one year, a national ID card or valid passport, and a credit or debit card for the refundable security deposit. International and EU driving licenses from all countries are accepted. No additional paperwork or international driving permit is required for most nationalities.

items.title: Age requirements and young driver policy
items.desc: The minimum age to rent a car at Tirana Airport is 21 years. Drivers aged 21–25 may be subject to a young driver surcharge depending on the vehicle category selected. There is no maximum age restriction. All drivers must present a valid driving license and be listed on the rental agreement at the time of pickup.

items.title: Insurance and coverage explained
items.desc: Every car in our Tirana Airport rental fleet includes basic Collision Damage Waiver (CDW) insurance at no extra cost. This covers damage to the vehicle above the standard excess amount. During online booking you can upgrade to Super CDW for full coverage with zero excess — strongly recommended for exploring Albania's mountain and coastal roads.

items.title: Driving in Albania — what to expect
items.desc: Albania's main roads are modern and well-maintained. The SH2 highway connects Tirana International Airport directly to the city center in around 20 minutes. Coastal roads along the Albanian Riviera and mountain passes are scenic but can be narrower — an SUV is recommended for off-the-beaten-path routes. Road signs follow European standards. Speed limits are 50 km/h in urban areas, 80 km/h on main roads, and 110 km/h on highways.

items.question: How does booking work?
items.answer: Choose your car, fill in the booking form with dates and your information, and confirm. You will receive a confirmation email immediately.

items.question: What documents are required?
items.answer: You need a valid driver's license (minimum 1 year), identity card or passport, and a credit/debit card for the deposit.

items.question: Can I pick up the car from the airport?
items.answer: Yes! We offer free pickup and return directly at Mother Teresa International Airport (TIA). Our team meets you at arrivals — no extra charge, no waiting.

items.question: Is there an extra fee for Tirana Airport pickup?
items.answer: No. Rent car tirana airport pickup and drop-off is completely free with no surcharges. The price you see when booking is the total price — nothing extra at the airport.

items.question: How do I find you at Tirana Airport?
items.answer: After landing, proceed to the arrivals hall. Our representative will be waiting with a sign bearing your name. You can also reach us by phone 24/7 at +355 69 756 2951.

items.question: What happens if the car breaks down?
items.answer: We have 24/7 assistance service. We will immediately send you help or a replacement car at no extra cost.

items.question: Can I cancel my booking?
items.answer: Yes, you can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the pickup date. After that, a cancellation fee applies.

items.question: What types of cars are available at Tirana Airport?
items.answer: Our Tirana Airport car rental fleet includes economy cars from €25/day, spacious family SUVs, premium luxury vehicles, and modern automatic transmission cars. All vehicles are regularly serviced, thoroughly cleaned before every rental, and less than 4 years old. You can filter the complete fleet by category, transmission, and price on our fleet page.

items.question: Can I return the car at Tirana Airport at any time?
items.answer: Yes, we accept vehicle returns at Tirana International Airport 24 hours a day, 7 days a week — including public holidays. Simply inform us of your return flight when booking and we will arrange everything. There is no extra charge for night, early morning, or weekend returns.

items.question: Is there an airport surcharge on the rental price?
items.answer: No — we charge absolutely no airport surcharge. Our prices are identical whether you pick up at Tirana Airport or at our city center location. This makes us one of the very few car rental tirana airport companies that offers truly transparent pricing at both locations with no hidden location fees.

items.question: How far is Tirana Airport from the city center?
items.answer: Mother Teresa International Airport (TIA) is located approximately 17 km northwest of Tirana city center. By car on the SH2 highway the drive takes 20-25 minutes in normal traffic. With our tirana airport rent a car service you avoid expensive taxis and crowded buses — and you can drive directly to your hotel or next destination.
